messages:
maria: Heads up — multiple customers reporting 502s for hosted /v1/generate around 17:12 UTC. Spike correlates with a high queue depth on edge nodes. Noticing more retries from clients. Can SRE triage?
incident-bot: deploy/event: deploy-frontend-2026-03-17 (id: d-778) completed at 17:05 UTC on cluster-prod-us-west.
raj: Investigating. grabbing envoy traces + logs now. initial glance: upstream reset errors (RST_STREAM) and 502s with upstream connection failure.
sophia: I see a small auth service rollout at 16:59 that touched the session-cache. Auth service p50 latency jumped from 12ms -> 120ms for ~3m around 17:10. Could be cascading.
maria: Customer repro snippet from one tenant (sanitized):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Client-Id: abc" -d '{"input":"..."}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
They included a ~2.5KB user metadata header.
tom: Repro locally by shoving bigger headers + concurrent connections (20 concurrent). I can reproduce 502s hitting edge with `envoy upstream connection reset` in logs.
raj: Envoy stats: h2 Conn Pool Exhausted / Streams Pending spiked. per-worker connection limit reached, backpressure -> 502s. Looks like when auth service latency increased, edge held connections open longer => pool saturation.
liam: Quick mitigation options: 1) increase upstream connection pool size on edge 2) enable prefix KV cache to reduce auth calls 3) short-term can roll back auth deploy if necessary. Which is fastest?
sophia: We rolled back the auth rollout to previous revision at 17:25 UTC. Auth latency dropped back to baseline by 17:27.
raj: After rollback: h2 pool depth recovered, 502 rate dropped ~90% within 2m. I'm doing a controlled rolling restart of edge proxy workers to clear stuck streams.
maria: Noted — I'm messaging the affected customers with temporary workaround (reduce concurrent streams, strip big headers) and ETA for full postmortem.
tom: For repro: here's the exact command I used to trigger (one-liner):
```
seq 1 40 | xargs -n1 -P20 -I{} curl -s -o /dev/null -H "X-User-Meta: $(head -c 2500 /dev/urandom | base64)" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
That reliably produced 502s when auth latency was high.
liam: I'll open a short-term envoy config tweak PR to raise `max_connection_retries` and upstream connection pool for the auth route, but prefer not to keep it long-term.
raj: Actions logged: 1) rolled back auth deploy (sophia) 2) rolled restart edge workers (raj) 3) created temporary envoy pool bump PR (liam) 4) customer comms (maria).
sophia: Filing an internal bug on auth's caching behavior — increased Redis latencies caused auth to block longer per request. Ticket: AUTH-6722.
maria: Customer update sent at 17:40 UTC — included repro steps and short-term mitigation. customers asked for timeline for root cause.
liam: We'll revert the pool bump after monitoring stable for 24h.
raj: Monitoring: 502s back to normal by 17:29, no new regressions in last 30m. Leaving thread open for postmortem and follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
maria: Thx all. I'll kick off postmortem doc and include logs/traces + easiest customer-facing wording.
incident-bot: reminder: create incident report within 24h (incident-template link)
